Methodology: the field is every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Fort Lauderdale dance searches on 29 Oct 2026. Each studio's site was crawled and graded across seven categories (AI readiness, SEO basics, page structure, content depth, social, image alt text, technical) on the same day. Google local positions come from four searches (ballroom dance lessons fort lauderdale fl, dance lessons fort lauderdale fl, salsa lessons fort lauderdale fl and wedding dance lessons fort lauderdale fl). AI visibility reflects live sessions in the public ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI apps, asked the two queries shown above; presence was confirmed by reading each engine's raw answer directly. FOR AI READINESS

In Fort Lauderdale, 18 studios compete for dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 18 dance and ballroom studios serving the Fort Lauderdale market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 49 to 92. The AI engines name only seven of the 18. The field averages 56 (D) on AI readiness, 18 of 18 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 12 of 18 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 29 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Fort Lauderdale, FL area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 18 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Simply Dancing & Art (92) and Nonstop Dance Company (86) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 49. Two scores are shared.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 56 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • None of the 18 studios has FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 12 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • Three of the 18 are franchise locations (two Fred Astaire and one Arthur Murray); the rest are independent studios.
  • One site in the field still isn't served over HTTPS — a critical flag browsers show visitors before they see a single class schedule.
  • The gap between #1 and #18 is 43 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Fort Lauderdale.” Studios that serve Fort Lauderdale from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (18 studios): simplydancingart.com, nonstopdancecompany.com, fajardoelite.com, fortlauderdalearthurmurray.com, goldcoastballroom.com, salsaninja.com, ftlballroom.com, fredastaire.com/imperial-point, local.latindancemovement.com, solanodance.com, fredastaire.com/hallandale-beach, dancewithpanache.com, myballroomlessonsftl.com, dancecircle.studio, dannydancemoves.com, starballroomdance.com, danceinflorida.com, davielatindance.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 29 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Fort Lauderdale dance searches. The South Florida coast is split into three pages: Miami (Miami-Dade), Fort Lauderdale (Broward) and Boca Raton (south Palm Beach County), with West Palm Beach covering the north of Palm Beach County. Star Ballroom's secure (https) address doesn't answer, so its site was checked at its plain http address. Gemini named Todos Club Dance Studio in Weston, which didn't appear in Google's local results for these searches. Left out: DanceNow1234 and Florida Dancesport (their websites are down), VK Dance Arena in Hallandale Beach (a children's program with ballet, breaking and hip-hop alongside ballroom), The Royal Peacock Studio (a dance-fitness and choreography studio), and the youth, ballet and hip-hop studios that lead the broad answers (Astrid Audet Academy of Ballet, Dance Dimensions, From The Top FTL, YC Dance Studio in Hollywood).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 29 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Fort Lauderdale, FL?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Fort Lauderdale, FL?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 29 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons fort lauderdale fl”; “dance lessons fort lauderdale fl”; “salsa lessons fort lauderdale fl”; “wedding dance lessons fort lauderdale fl”; “ballroom dance lessons hollywood fl”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in fort lauderdale fl” and “ballroom dance studio fort lauderdale”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
